# sportradar-api

**Tag**: web

## 简介

Ruby wrapper for interacting with the SportRadar API. SportRadar has over 23 published APIs. This library aims to support them incrementally. Contributions welcome!

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/beneggett/sportradar-api
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/sportradar-api/0.20.2
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/sportradar-api
